content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Also runs consumer dating apps selling premium subscriptions and in-app features to adult users, matching Match's core business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Sells mobile advertising and app distribution software to developers and carriers, a B2B ad-tech business unlike consumer dating."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"B2B software measuring digital ad quality for advertisers and publishers, a different business from consumer dating apps."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Online sports betting and casino operator earning gaming margins, not a subscription-based dating platform."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Consumer security and identity protection subscriptions plus personal finance products, a different consumer software business."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Operates a social dating app selling premium memberships and in-app advertising to adult users, closely matching Match's model."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Televised and online retailer of physical merchandise, earning product sales rather than platform subscriptions."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"B2B content recommendation and native advertising platform for publishers and advertisers, unrelated to dating."}]}
